profileScope.phaseRunnerChangeFrom49: Only profiler output directory and descriptive actual52 label; no benchmark operation/validation changes.

checkAllocationComparison.method: One visit per raw heap node; sum selfSize only, normalize generated function names, require actual image URL. Same strict definite-name-read classification as retained49 partition. Group totals overlap by definition and must not be added together.

limitations: Normal ABBA comparisons are actual emitted49 versus actual emitted52 on identical frozen inputs, not native-seed comparisons. Two observations per version do not establish a confidence interval or general performance guarantee.
Before/after load, allowed affinity and proc/cpuinfo MHz snapshots are retained, but not controlled CPU frequency or hardware counters. Scheduler/thermal/VM/background-GC confounding remains.
Allocation figures are single-run statistical cumulative-byte point estimates including collected objects, not exact allocation counts or live heap. They are separate from normal benchmark timings.
CPU profile self attribution can fold inlined work into callers. Worker GC samples are not total process/background GC CPU.
Unchanged helper starts CPU profiling before allocation-sampler setup; tiny phases can be dominated by inspector overhead. No overhead subtraction or logical-scheduler-cost claim.
Historical49 profile and current52 profile are not contemporaneous ABBA allocation experiments. Site movement/inlining/sampling noise can affect attribution.
